name: FMHY Wiki
subtitle: The FMHY wiki, offline-first
description:
An unofficial FMHY client for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Browse every section of the wiki, keep bookmarks, and let the content update itself in the background.

Content comes from the community-maintained FMHY wiki (fmhy.net). This app is not affiliated with the FMHY team.

apps.name: FMHY
apps.subtitle: The FMHY wiki, offline-first
apps.localizedDescription: Every FMHY section on your device: browse, search, bookmark and share links without waiting on a website. Section content updates silently from the wiki's GitHub repository, so new links show up without an App Store update.
